who: Historian and sociologist of French colonialism at Columbia, PhD EHESS 2001.

who: Historian of colonial America and women at Mississippi State, PhD Delaware.

Mississippi State History's obituary for its former professor records a history PhD from the University of Delaware and employment in its history department.
The Elizabeth I. Nybakken authority cites Family and society in American history (2001) and The Centinel, warnings of a revolution (1979).

notes: The publisher explicitly places the LC-authorized name and matching book at Mississippi State during the relevant period; the department confirms the Delaware doctorate.
